They are both bent forward, leaning with their hands on their thighs, smiling directly at the camera. Floating numbers '153' and '138' appear above their heads. The woman on the right stands beside her, looking briefly to the side then back to the viewer. Large numbers '170' and '153' appear above their heads along with question marks. An electronic dartboard is clearly visible in the background on the right wall.
